name: Lessons Learned
controllingIdea: Mistakes and challenges shape us into the agents our clients need.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A past mistake, challenge, or difficult moment admitted
narrativeArc.risingAction: What happened and why - the honest reflection
narrativeArc.crisis: The consequence, failure, or realization moment
narrativeArc.resolution: How it made you better, invitation for others to learn

triggerMoments.moment: Recent situation reminded of past lesson

questions.question: What mistake or challenge taught you an important lesson?
questions.placeholder: Early in my career, I let a deal fall apart because I didn't...

questions.question: What happened? What went wrong?
questions.placeholder: The inspection revealed issues I should have anticipated...

questions.question: What was the consequence or realization?
questions.placeholder: My clients lost the house they loved, and I felt responsible...

questions.question: What did you learn? How did it change you?
questions.placeholder: Now I always do a pre-inspection walkthrough before offers...

questions.question: What would you tell someone facing a similar situation?
questions.placeholder: Trust your gut, ask the hard questions, never assume...

promptConfig.systemContext: This is a vulnerability and growth story. The agent shares a real failure or challenge honestly. Focus on the lesson, not victimhood. This builds trust through authenticity.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Honest, reflective, not self-pitying. The goal is wisdom, not sympathy. Show growth and help others avoid the same mistake.

usageHints: Be genuinely vulnerable - fake humility shows
Focus on the lesson, not the failure

exampleScenarios.title: The Deal I Lost
exampleScenarios.situation: Sharing a failed transaction and the lesson
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Three years ago, I let a first-time buyer rush into a condo without a proper reserve study review. The HOA had a $50k special assessment 6 months later. I learned to always request financials, no matter what.

expectedOutput.hook: I cost my client $50,000. Here's what I learned.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: Now I request HOA financials before every condo offer. No exceptions.
